product.backbone: Muse understands your activity. Reviewed rules and deterministic engines keep the records.
product.taxUnknown: Your tax amount has not been determined. Review the missing facts and approved rule coverage.
product.startTransactions: Upload a receipt or tell BiG-M what happened. Review the candidate before posting.
product.ruleBoundary: Muse understands. Governed packs supply candidate rules. Deterministic resolvers decide applicability; engines calculate and record. You confirm.
product.packScope: These are context-related candidates, not an applicability or legal approval. Source verification is separate from executable approval.
product.noPacks: Provide the business context before reviewing relevant rule coverage.
product.status.FAILED: Could not finish; review or retry
product.reason.READY: A scoped deterministic result is ready for review.
product.reason.REVIEW_REQUIRED: Business confirmation does not approve tax rules or treaty treatment.
product.reason.MISSING_INFORMATION: The tax event, jurisdiction basis or governed required facts need explicit review. Bookkeeping can continue.
product.reason.OUT_OF_PERIOD: The evaluated rule coverage does not cover this period. Do not extend an older rule silently.
product.reason.MISSING_APPROVED_RULE: Relevant candidates have not been approved as executable rules. An unresolved tax amount is not zero.
product.reason.TREATY_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Cross-border context needs a separate treaty applicability review. A foreign customer does not establish treaty relief.
product.reviewFields: Check the date, accounts, payment and other required fields before confirming.
product.errorMuse: Muse is temporarily unavailable. Showing available deterministic information; use direct entry or retry later.
product.errorFx: A reviewed historical FX rate is required. Other bookkeeping can continue.
product.errorDocument: This document could not be read. Use PDF, PNG, JPEG, text or simple CSV up to 8 MiB, or enter the activity directly.
product.errorPosting: Posting was not completed. Review the candidate and retry the same confirmation to avoid creating an extra transaction.
product.recordedFx: Recorded Frankfurter demo rate; not a new live lookup
product.noReport: No recorded activity yet. Reports appear after confirmed posting.
product.assistantBoundary: Muse explains your confirmed context and recorded results. Amounts come from the engines; rule approval remains a separate review.
product.assistantEmpty: Ask about your business, missing tax information or recorded results.
product.taxQuestion: Why is my tax not ready?
product.reportQuestion: Explain my business results and revenue.
product.demoNote: Synthetic demo workspace. Results use the real engines. FX uses a labelled recorded fixture; live Muse requires explicit opt-in.
cognitive.treatyReview: Cross-border context is present; treaty applicability is not established. Research candidates are not approved treaty relief.
product.demoTaxScope: Demo scope: Indonesian individual ordinary income for 2026. This explores requirements; it does not confirm tax residence or approve any rule.
product.taxFact.BUSINESS_CAPACITY: Capacity in which income is earned
position.cash: Cash actually received: {amount}. Outstanding contract balances and opening funds are excluded.
position.receivables: Clients contractually still owe: {amounts}. These are original-currency contract balances, not cash or automatically recognized accounts receivable; no new FX valuation was invented.
position.card: Card liability: {liability}. Card repayments of {repayments} debit the card liability and credit bank; the purchase was recorded separately, so repayment is not another expense.
position.spending: Purchases total {total}: business-classified spending {business}, personal {personal}, mixed {mixed}. Recognized business expenses are {recognized}; another {review} of business purchases needs expense-versus-asset review. Card repayments are excluded. Business classification does not establish tax deductibility.
position.incomeTypes: Received by category: {categories}. Advances of {advances} remain a liability; employment wages of {wages} are separate from business income. Licence receipts retain their licence/IP facts and require tax classification review.
position.countries: Citizenship {citizenship}; home {home}; current physical location {physical}; work {work}. Temporary travel: {days} days. Entity declaration: {entity}. Tax residence: {residence}; registration: {registration}. Payer countries: {payers}. Payer country is not automatically an income source or proof of taxation.
position.tax: Final tax cannot yet be reliably determined. Blockers: {blockers}. No zero tax, withholding rate or treaty benefit is assumed.
position.profit: Recorded business income {income}, recognized business expenses {expenses}, provisional recorded net {net}. Final business profit is not reliable while mixed purchases of {mixed} and business asset/expense review of {review} remain unresolved. Advances and personal wages are separate.
position.bank: Recorded bank balance: {amount}. This includes opening funds and is different from cash received during the recorded period.
position.hotel: Hotel remains mixed-purpose pending allocation review. Your recorded reason: {reason}. No business percentage, full business expense or tax deduction was invented.
position.policy: There are {count} accounting/tax review items: mixed-use allocation, licence/IP treatment, advances and expense-versus-asset policy. Confirmed purchases and payments remain recorded; uncertain treatment is not silently approved.
position.treaties: Potential research contexts: {contexts}. Treaty applicability is not established by citizenship, home or payer alone. Missing approved coverage remains review-required.
position.confirmed: The recorded data contains {engagements} income engagements and balanced journals: {balanced}. Human-confirmed records are distinct from unapproved law, unknown withholding and unallocated costs.
position.blocker.APPROVED_COUNTRY_PACK_C: approved CountryPack coverage is missing or unestablished
position.blocker.PAYER_COUNTRY_DOES_NOT_: income source is not established from payer country
position.blocker.WITHHOLDING_CERTIFICATE: withholding certificates are missing; amounts remain unknown
position.blocker.IP_TAX_CLASSIFICATION_R: software licence/IP tax classification is unresolved
position.blocker.ALLOCATION_REVIEW_REQUI: mixed costs have no approved allocation
financial.boundary: Confirm the observed financial event separately from tax treatment. Advances are liabilities; card repayment settles debt. Mixed costs and uncertain asset policy remain in review clearing without an invented business percentage.
financial.contractualNote: Original-currency contract balances are separate from cash and recognized ledger receivables. No reporting FX value is invented.
financial.policyReview: Business purchase policy still under review
financial.profitPending: Final business profit and tax are not reliably determined while allocation, asset/expense policy and governed rules remain unresolved.
financial.scopeNote: The bookkeeping table contains recognized business income and expenses; wages, advances and unresolved purchase classifications are shown separately above.
financial.positionQuestion: Explain my financial position in simple language.
position.blocker.TAX_SCOPE_REQUIRED: a scoped governed tax review is required
financial.hotelQuestion: You described a vacation with remote work. Was this hotel personal, business-related or mixed? Record your purpose and reason; no allocation percentage is assumed.
financial.transportQuestion: Were fuel and transport used for client meetings, personal travel or both? Record your purpose and reason.
financial.mixedQuestion: Describe the business and personal use before confirming this purchase. No business-use percentage is assumed.
